root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `checkstackGC(L, fsize)` can raise on the tail-call path, the reused caller frame must still expose the caller code base rather than the callee `p->code`; otherwise the surviving caller `savedpc` is paired with the callee debug tables.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original moves the callee closure into `ci->func` before the stack-growth check, so the reused frame already names the callee code array when `checkstackGC(L, fsize)` raises. The authoritative fixed image leaves the caller code array in place through the same protected event and only rewrites the frame after the stack check succeeds.
root_cause_criterion.evidence: Vulnerable original: tailcall_stack_guard.frame_code_base=0x608000000120 == tailcall_stack_guard.callee_code_base=0x608000000120. Fixed original: tailcall_stack_guard.frame_code_base=0x604000000390 != tailcall_stack_guard.callee_code_base=0x608000000120 while currentpc_state still executes.

nodes.state: `currentpc()` reads the callee code base through `ci_func(ci)->p->code`, so the partially rewritten `CallInfo` makes debug lookup interpret the frame as the callee on the crashing vulnerable path.
nodes.evidence: Vulnerable original: currentpc_state.frame_code_base=0x608000000120, matching the callee code base captured at the tail-call stack check.

nodes.state: `currentpc()` reuses the caller `savedpc` pointer unchanged when it computes the instruction index for the now-callee frame.
nodes.evidence: Both originals witness the same savedpc pointer across the root and currentpc events; vulnerable original: tailcall_stack_guard.savedpc_ptr=0x6040000003ac == currentpc_state.savedpc_ptr=0x6040000003ac.

nodes.state: The sink loop at `baseline += f->lineinfo[basepc]` walks `f->lineinfo` with the `pc` returned by `currentpc()`. In the vulnerable witness, that `pc` is 162 while `lineinfo_size` is only 21, so the read runs off the end of the callee lineinfo table.
nodes.evidence: Vulnerable original: lineinfo_walk.pc_index=162 with lineinfo_walk.lineinfo_size=21 at the crashing sink event.

edges.relation: The callee code base exposed by the premature frame rewrite is the same code base that `currentpc()` later reads from `ci_func(ci)->p->code` on the crashing vulnerable path.
The caller savedpc pointer that survives the failing tail-call stack check is the same pointer that `currentpc()` later subtracts from the callee debug tables.
The exact instruction index returned by `currentpc()` is passed unchanged as the `pc` argument that drives the sink `lineinfo` walk in `luaG_getfuncline()`.
